I have a code fix for this in place that results in this response to the user:

$> curl -i http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest -XPOST -H"Link: <http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#Resource>; rel=\"type\""
    HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
    Server: Apache-Coyote/1.1
    Link: <http://localhost:8080/static/constraints/CannotCreateResourceException.rdf> rel="http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#constrainedBy"
    Content-Type: text/plain;charset=utf-8 
    Content-Length: 29
    Date: Fri, 07 Apr 2017 19:58:13 GMT
    Connection: close

    LDPR creation not implemented
But I don't want to make a PR on this until this PR is accepted:
Since this code needs the same fix, as evidenced by the constraint link being incorrect above.
Here's the message snippet in the constraints file:

<rdf:RDF
    xmlns:rdfs="http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#"
    xmlns:owl="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#"
    xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#"
    xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#">
    <owl:Ontology rdf:about="static/constraints/ConstraintNotImplementedException">
      <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">Cannot Create Resource</rdfs:label>
      <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">Fedora is unable to create the requested resource. Fedora will
        not create a resource of type LDP Resource. The type specified must be a subclass of
        LDP Resource.
      </rdfs:comment>
    </owl:Ontology>
</rdf:RDF>
When trying to create an ldp:Resource, Fedora responds with a 501 Not implemented. A ldp:constrainedBy link should be included.

comments.body: Unknown, can you provide an example curl request that someone could use to replicate the behavior you are seeing?

For example:

curl -i http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest -XPOST -H"Link: <http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#Resource>; rel=\"type\""

It looks like ServerErrorException:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/blob/master/fcrepo-http-api/src/main/java/org/fcrepo/http/api/FedoraLdp.java#L759

..should be replaced by a new sub-class of ConstraintViolationException:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/blob/master/fcrepo-kernel-api/src/main/java/org/fcrepo/kernel/api/exception/ConstraintViolationException.java

..and include an appropriate constraint document, ala:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/tree/master/fcrepo-webapp/src/main/webapp/static/constraints

Frank smutniak, would you be interested in giving this ticket a look?
